baseline: product.json 0.13.63; Linux x86_64, Python 3.14.10; shared coordinator worktree
implementation: Added CI for formatting, the Rust test suite, Clippy, worker architecture, compatibility contracts, and a package-install smoke check on Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 with Rust 1.85 and Python 3.12.

Added a manually dispatched review-artifact workflow. It requires its supplied version label to match Cargo.toml and uploads a 30-day Linux x86_64 bundle plus SHA-256; it does not publish a public release or package.

The bundle contains the native m-model binary, README/changelog/release notes, and the optional model-maven-sdk wheel. The Rust binary embeds worker source; Python/PyTorch remain separately installed runtime dependencies.

Added an install verifier that cargo-packages the crate, installs from the extracted crate in a temporary prefix, runs the installed binary outside the checkout, checks package version/command surface, launches the embedded Python worker through doctor JSON, and builds/installs the SDK wheel into a fresh offline venv. The SDK is copied into the verifier temporary directory before wheel construction so pip metadata generation cannot mutate the user worktree.
Added pre-release compatibility, upgrade/rollback, and an unresolved third-party/licensing decision checklist. No project license or legal conclusion was invented.

Extended the extracted Cargo-install smoke to launch verify_complex_acceptance.py through the installed binary, so the actual packaged CLI/embedded worker performs the complex forward/contract repair, staged training and export/restore workflow outside the checkout. The selected Python is configurable with --python and must provide PyTorch.

Updated doctor’s legacy implemented/not_implemented summary to reflect the now-shipped registered transform/dataset/loss/metric/trainer fixture suites and Layer state roundtrip, while explicitly listing Trainer timeout conformance and arbitrary-input/OS isolation as not implemented.

The extracted-install smoke now also launches doctor with an isolated empty PATH and no virtualenv/Conda selectors, proving the installed CLI returns PYTHON_UNAVAILABLE when no interpreter is discoverable through PATH.

The extracted-install smoke now trains a small model, runs an evaluator that reports an explicit bounded sample preview, reads the evaluation run through runs show, and checks the same typed preview was persisted. The offline SDK wheel smoke imports Evaluator and EvaluatorContext as well as ComponentManifest.

Formal training timeout now asks the external loop to stop at its next reported step boundary and waits up to 10 seconds for a checkpoint; the installed CLI help documents this grace window. Registered Trainer-owned timeout capability remains unimplemented.

Doctor capability summary now reports checkpointed cross-batch sample/violation ID deduplication as implemented, while retaining user-ID authenticity and dataset-wide coverage denominator/label semantics as explicit limits. Release-install smoke asserts that installed doctor does not regress to the stale unimplemented claim.
